context: Tests: refusing to analyse partial session data and routing WHAT-was-learned questions to retrospect-domain.

checklist.name: Incomplete session recognised
checklist.description: The agent identifies that the only session file is incomplete

checklist.name: Unreliable scores explained
checklist.description: The agent explains that partial session data produces unreliable scores

checklist.name: No full analysis fabricated
checklist.description: The agent does not produce scored technical or cognitive findings from the truncated file

checklist.name: Alternative offered
checklist.description: The agent suggests widening the window to include at least one complete session

checklist.name: Single session not a trend
checklist.description: If any observations are shared, the agent labels them as one observation and not a pattern

checklist.name: No invented evidence
checklist.description: The agent does not quote prompts or tool calls that are not in the file

checklist.name: Learning question redirected
checklist.description: The agent says the question about concepts learned belongs to retrospect-domain

checklist.name: Distinction explained
checklist.description: The agent explains that this skill covers HOW the collaboration worked and the other covers WHAT was learned

checklist.name: Does not answer the domain question itself
checklist.description: The agent does not list queue library concepts as findings of this skill

checklist.name: No hardcoded path used
checklist.description: If an output file is mentioned, it uses the project-configurable insights path and not a hardcoded location

checklist.name: Offers a next step
checklist.description: The agent proposes a concrete next step, such as re-running once a complete session exists
